verdict_reason: The contact-page removal is correct and leaves no stale references, but it left a duplicate review-page landing check after answerRolesAndAddresses.

todos.issue: With the contact page gone, lines 149-152 (toHaveURL notification-view + checkAnswersCopy heading) repeat exactly what answerRolesAndAddresses already asserts as its last step (saveAndExpectLanding(page, LANDINGS.notificationView) at live-animals-journey.js:1124, which checks the same URL and the exact heading). Removing the contact step left two back-to-back copies of one landing check, and the reader cannot tell which one the test's 'through to the review page' claim rests on.
todos.fix: Must: the test checks the review-page landing once, in one place. One way: delete lines 149-152, since answerRolesAndAddresses already ends with expectLanding on LANDINGS.notificationView; or keep them and have the test call a helper variant that stops on the addresses page.
